content_sections.heading: Cantonment Board Pachmarhi Civil Engineer Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for Cantonment Board Pachmarhi Civil Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Civil Engineer position at Cantonment Board Pachmarhi is scheduled for 12th October 2026. Candidates should ensure they report to the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Civil Engineer post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification for the Civil Engineer post is a Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized institution. Ensure you meet this criterion before attending the interview.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Civil Engineer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Civil Engineer post in the Cantonment Board Pachmarhi recruitment 2026. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q6. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the Cantonment Board Pachmarhi located?
faq.answer: Cantonment Board Pachmarhi is located in Pachmarhi, Madhya Pradesh. The specific interview venue will be detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for the Civil Engineer position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Civil Engineer position is Contractual. This means the appointment will be for a fixed period as per the terms of the contract.

faq.question: Q9. Is there an age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify an age limit for this recruitment. It is advisable to check the detailed notification for any age-related information.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Civil Engineer role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Civil Engineer role at Cantonment Board Pachmarhi will be based on an Interview. Candidates who perform well in the interview will be considered for the position.
